result:
Perfect! The fix is complete. The route is now properly wired and passes all checks.

## Summary

The `/admin/posts` endpoint was 404 because the admin routes file wasn't being imported and called. The endpoint code and route definition already existed in `routes/admin.ts` and `app/Http/Controllers/AdminPostController.ts`, but the route registrar wasn't connected to the main route registration flow.

**Changes made:**
- Added import of `registerAdminRoutes` from `routes/admin.ts` in `routes/web.ts` (line 7)
- Added call to `registerAdminRoutes(router)` at the end of `registerWebRoutes()` function (line 49)

This enables the `GET /admin/posts` endpoint which returns JSON with all posts (`{ data: [...] }`) with author information, and properly redirects unauthenticated users to `/login` instead of showing a 404. All type checks pass and the test suite passes.
